drifted.spec_text: System MUST define an IDispatcher interface providing initialize, shutdown, lookup, lookup_async, check, remove, populate, prepare_store, commit_store, cancel_store, and touch methods.
drifted.actual: Interface additionally includes batch_lookup(entries: &[(CacheKey, IpcHandle)]) -> Vec<Result<(), DispatcherError>> for parallel cold promotion

drifted.spec_text: Phase 1 issues up to 16 concurrent NVMe reads directly into unique offsets of the memory-tier slot
drifted.actual: Pipeline accepts max_queue_depth parameter; single-entry path uses 16, batch path uses 16/num_queues (8 with 2 queues/drive) to prevent NVMe submission queue overflow

drifted.spec_text: promote_and_serve promotes a single cold entry sequentially via pipelined reader
drifted.actual: batch_lookup additionally promotes multiple cold entries concurrently with per-drive parallelism (std::thread::scope) and multi-queue threads (MAX_QUEUES_PER_DRIVE=2)

unspecced.feature: batch_lookup with parallel per-drive multi-queue cold promotion
